title: Search diagnostics and artifact-backed literature UI
description: Adds SearchDiagnostic to the literature-research Chain-of-Evidence contract and records search_diagnostics.jsonl as a first-class workspace artifact for retrieval quality review.
changes: Add SearchDiagnostic schema with query, user_query, intent, sources, counts, failure_mode, and notes.
Require search_diagnostics.jsonl in the literature research workspace contract.
Clarify that insufficient retrieval evidence must not become a novelty or gap claim.

rollback.notes: Restore Chain-of-Evidence workflow without first-class SearchDiagnostic artifacts.
